runs.question: Under what conditions is a student awarded an I (Incomplete) grade?
runs.answer:
A student is awarded an 'I' (Incomplete) grade in the following conditions:

1. On their request to denote incomplete performance in a course, with approval of an instructor.
2. In case of missing an evaluation component due to absence on medical grounds or other special circumstances.
3. Requests for 'I' grade should be made at the earliest but not later than the last day of major tests.
4. All evaluation requirements for such students in the corresponding course(s) should be completed on or before the last date of add and drop of courses specified in the academic calendar.

Source: reg_pg_2022.pdf, page 11

runs.question: Which courses make up the first-year common curriculum of the B.Tech. programme?
runs.answer:
The first-year common curriculum of the B.Tech. programme consists of the following courses:

* Institute Core (I) courses:
	+ Engineering (IE) - 34 credits
	+ Science (IS) - 16 credits
	+ Humanities (IH) - 12 credits
* Programme Linked (L) courses:
	+ Science (LS) - 7 credits
* Programme Core (P) courses:
	+ Programme Compulsory (PC) - 50 credits
	+ Programme Electives (PE) - 18 credits

Source: reg_2019.pdf, page 17

runs.question: As per the 2024 examination policy, what is the minimum weightage of the Major examination?

The minimum weightage of the Major examination is not less than 40% of the overall evaluation. 

Source: amend_exam_2024.md
